goal: Ensure transaction index lookups raise database errors instead of falsely reporting missing transactions
Prevents silent data lookup failures caused by underlying disk corruption or read failures
agreement: Suggested providing a plyvel test script in a comment for reviewers (maflcko)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because silently misreporting corrupted index data as absent transactions threatens data integrity
Ensures nodes fail explicitly on disk read errors rather than giving callers false negative answers
